name: @kickside/agents-ui
title: KickSide Agents
description: Agents control page web component for kickside/agents, over the native user-agents CRUD API.

wippy.description: Builds five web components for kickside/agents, served from /kickside-agents; the primary tag is kickside-agents, the Agents control page the host nav mounts by tag — it fetches its own data over the user-agents CRUD API, takes no props, and emits only the lifecycle events load, unload, error, and invalid. The same bundle ships wc-agent-picker (entry agent_picker.js): props selected (array of agent refs), multi (boolean, default true), placeholder, and value (config-host convention — a JSON object string whose agent_id names the selection, or a bare agent ref; presence switches it to single-select), emitting change with detail { selected, labels, agent_id }. wc-agent-trait-picker (entry agent_trait_picker.js) accepts value as a JSON string { traits: string[], trait_contexts: Record<string, unknown> } and emits change with that object in event detail; it loads the public agent trait catalog itself and renders selection, tint, badges, collapsible settings, and per-trait context. wc-agent-edit (entry agent_edit.js) wraps the shared AgentForm editor: parent-id selects create mode, while component-id, entry-id, or the host route channel selects edit mode; it emits saved, created, and close, each with { id }. kickside-master-namespace-picker (entry master_picker.js) edits a master capability's scope: it receives the capability context via the config prop and reports { namespaces, trait_ids, inject_trait_catalog } via config-changed. The wippy.props block below describes only the primary kickside-agents tag (intentionally empty); per-tag props schemas live in the module registry's view.component entries.
